info.name: Task Manager API
info.description: Run folders in order against a fresh DB. Set collection variables parentId / subtaskId from the ids returned by 'Create parent' / 'Create subtask'. Lines marked [NNN] assert that status code.

item.name: [502] Impossible date in text (parser output rejected)
[201] Create with key (retry, same body -> replay)
[400] Invalid body with new key (not stored)
[201] Breakdown with key (1st) - set parentId first
